topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Oh no, seriously? Your flight got delayed and you missed it? That's just brutal, man. I can't even imagine what you're going through right now. All that planning, and then… poof. I know how much you were looking forward to it, and to have it slip away like that? Ugh, it's so unfair. I wish I could have done something, been there with you. Listen, whenever you're ready to talk, I’m here—just hit me up. And who knows, maybe there's still a chance, a way to make it work. We can brainstorm, figure something out. Don’t give up hope yet, seriously.
